title: IAEA Live Chart: 56Fe is listed stable, abundance 91.754
summary: The Live Chart ground-state row for 56Fe says STABLE and lists abundance 91.754.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 56Fe (Z=26, N=30), extracted 2026-11-18, lists the half-life field as STABLE and the abundance field as 91.754 with unc_a 0.106. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 29-Oct-2009. Abundance here is the column in that row, not a new assay.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 56Fe
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides
sources.note: CSV row extracted 2026-11-18. ENSDF cut-off field: 29-Oct-2009.

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.
